testcase.name: nothing is sent unless the transport is in its steady state
the cycle is spent once per surface and degrades to the nudge
a phone that has left the link is a disconnect, not a stall
a cold start is left to the phone's own sink setup
the escalation window stays clear of the slowest unaided first frame
a warm relaunch with no picture gets the focus cycle
the nudge respects the shared keyframe throttle
a session with no link activity at all is never escalated
a phone that is silent on video but present on the link still gets the cycle
a picture on screen is never disturbed
a fresh surface is given the healthy path's own worst case first
